big-news.text: On Monday, Oslo District Court ruled that Marius Borg Høiby can be released from custody at Skaugum, with a duty to report to police and drug and alcohol testing. Police appealed and want him kept in custody until the appeal court decides, so he isn't out yet.

About 2,800 troops from ten European countries will hold the first exercise of a new multinational force for Ukraine in southeast Poland, from Nov 9 to 22. The force is meant to deploy only after a ceasefire.

oslo.text: A new high-security psychiatric unit with 64 beds has opened at Nedre Ila in Bærum.

be-aware.text: Police are investigating a sixth dead cat, found at Holmen in west Oslo, and checking whether it's linked to the earlier killings in west Oslo and Bærum.
There are no weather warnings, but clear, cold nights this week could bring morning frost and slippery patches. That's worth knowing when you're back on the bike.

fun-and-free.text: Top pick: Fjord Oslo runs from 18:00 to 23:00 until Sunday, along the waterfront from Tjuvholmen and Aker Brygge to Rådhusplassen and Akershusstranda.
Saturday's free percussion concert at 15:00 at the Norwegian Academy of Music is still on.
